concept: One ordinary office, drawn plainly in calm daylight: Maya's open-plan floor where the vague verdict happens in passing, and a small quiet meeting room where the same update is replayed with the four moves. Moving right is moving forward through the lesson, moving down is going underneath a scene (the reasons, inside Maya's head), and zooming in is going into the report's seat and screen. The motifs that travel are the client update, the calendar that carries the days, the report's thought aside and the four-move card that waits in the corner and ticks as each move lands.

design.treatment: An ordinary open-plan office in daylight (Loom.place.office). Maya, the manager, stands by her desk at left; her report sits at the next desk, seen from behind, the client update open on their monitor. On the wall a tear-off calendar turns over a few days. Calm, documentary framing; one slow push from the wide room to the report's desk.
design.why_motion: time passing is the point: the update went out days ago, so the calendar turning over is content, and the push carries the eye from Maya to the work.

design.treatment: A wipe to the left (rewind) opens on a small quiet meeting room the same afternoon: Maya across the table facing us, the report in the foreground from behind (over the shoulder), the update on the table between them, the four-move card waiting in the top-right corner. One push from the wide room to the two-shot. Same room in every meeting beat: Loom.place.meeting with the name "room" and the same options, Maya at the same x, the report at the same place, so st_room_a, st_room_b and st_room_c (one place in the world) read as one continuous room.
